note: 36-inch Mortar T1 (Little David), Aberdeen Proving Ground, 6 July 1945: the right side of the tube at 65 degrees firing elevation, a photograph taken close enough that the tube reads about seven per cent wider at its foot than at its muzzle. No scale: the tube is taken as 1.30 m across (a 914 mm bore in 19 cm walls), 88.6 px, which is 68.2 px/m and puts the muzzle 6.6 m from the trunnions. Pinned on the trunnion cap. The three-quarter view at 0 degrees (shots/ref/am_david_a.jpg) is a perspective and is read, not laid over.
